Each term is the product of two consecutive integers:

1·2 = 2  
2·3 = 6  
3·4 = 12  
4·5 = 20  
5·6 = 30  

Hence the n-th term (with n starting at 1) is  
aₙ = n·(n + 1) = n² + n.
